earlier_sources: https://github.com/librefonts/cherrycreamsoda at d378933eaf1dcc111ad2599e41014cb15fbd3788: the font as built, dumped to TTX, and its metadata; no source.
disclose: The release kerns with a legacy `kern` table (1125 pairs) and has no GPOS; these sources kern through a GPOS kern feature, which is how fontc builds kerning. HarfBuzz shapes every kerned pair alike in both (the functional gate). Decided 2026-10-01: releases with an old kern table are accepted and disclosed.

The released font is hinted (TrueType instructions). These sources carry no TrueType instructions, so the build is hinted by ttfautohint: the outlines, spacing and layout are the release's, its rendering at small sizes under a TrueType interpreter is not. Hinting is not compared by the gates.
